# Bundles

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from internal/catalog/manifest.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every bundle dashkit can install. Microsoft's are pinned to `microsoft/skills-for-fabric` at `v0.3.11`;
data-goblin's are installed through your tool's own plugin manager and follow that project's releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Each installed skill competes for the agent's attention in every session its scope covers. Install the
> bundles a project actually uses, into that project.

## From Microsoft

Downloaded at the pinned tag and written into each tool's native format.

## From data-goblin

Installed by Claude Code or Copilot CLI themselves. dashkit never copies these files: the project's
licence does not allow it, and letting the host own them means their weekly updates and hooks keep
working. Tools without a plugin manager are skipped with an explanation.

<details>
<summary><strong>PBIP guardrails</strong> &ensp;<code>goblin-pbip</code> &ensp;data-goblin · 3 skills · 3 guardrail hooks</summary>

Checks PBIR structure, TMDL syntax and report-to-model binding automatically after every edit, with PBIR and TMDL format references. Ships native validators for macOS, Linux and Windows.

Checks that run automatically, without being asked:

- PBIR structure and schema, after any edit inside a .Report folder
- TMDL syntax, after any .tmdl edit
- report-to-model binding, after definition.pbir edits

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`pbip`](https://github.com/data-goblin/power-bi-agentic-development/tree/main/plugins/pbip/skills/pbip) | |
| [`pbir-format`](https://github.com/data-goblin/power-bi-agentic-development/tree/main/plugins/pbip/skills/pbir-format) | |
| [`tmdl`](https://github.com/data-goblin/power-bi-agentic-development/tree/main/plugins/pbip/skills/tmdl) | |

</details>

<summary><strong>Live model guardrails</strong> &ensp;<code>goblin-pbi-desktop</code> &ensp;data-goblin · 1 skill · 3 guardrail hooks</summary>

- referential integrity after relationship or key-column changes
